name: agent-config-bridge
description: Bridge project-level agent configuration between Claude Code and Codex: a read-only drift sentinel and a plan-confirm-write sync for project skills, entry instructions, rule shards, and hook intents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Claude Code and Codex project config in sync
interface.longDescription: Agent Config Bridge keeps one canonical source for a project's agent skills, entry instructions, rule shards, and hook intents, then projects it into the host-native Claude Code and Codex layouts. bridge-sentinel reports drift without writing; bridge-sync plans, confirms, and reconciles writes with Git-proven baselines.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-config-bridge:bridge-sentinel to check this repository for agent-configuration drift without modifying files.
Use $agent-config-bridge:bridge-sync to plan, confirm, and reconcile Bridge-managed writes in this repository.
